name: search_books
description: Search Bookshelf's ebook metadata and display selectable candidates. Each candidate includes a short-lived request_token bound to the exact verified book and original query; pass only that request_token to request_book, never candidate_id. If no candidates are returned, relay the ambiguity honestly: metadata search may be temporarily unavailable, so advise retrying in a few minutes. Never automatically select one; always present candidates and require an explicit user choice before request_book.

query.description: Required book title or author query (trimmed, maximum 200 characters).

limit.description: Maximum number of candidates to display (default 5, minimum 1, maximum 10).
